parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper sliding glass pane of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It allows light to pass through and can be moved vertically to open or close the window for ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically within the window frame along a guided track.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower sliding glass pane of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It can be lifted to open the window, allowing airflow while maintaining visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically within the frame, typically sliding upward to open.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glass panes in place and provides the track for their movement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support structure for the sliding panes.
